name: Waffy
ingredients_raw: SUGAR, REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), MALTODEXTRIN, REFINED PALM OIL, HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE OIL, EMULSIFIER [INS 322 (i)], REFINED PALM KERNEL OIL, ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (PINEAPPLE), COLOUR (INS 102, INS 133), IODIZED SALT, RAISING AGENT [INS 500(ii)], PINEAPPLE FRUIT POWDER (0.01%), FLOUR TREATMENT AGENTS (INS 223, INS 1100, INS 1101) AND ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS 296). ALLERGEN: Contains Wheat, Soy & Sulphites. May Contain Milk & Nuts.
